name: texact
title: TeXact
description: TeXact lets you calculate, simplify, solve, differentiate, integrate, and sum LaTeX-style math directly from Raycast.
author: artush_aydinyan

commands.name: calculate
commands.title: Calculate with TeXact
commands.subtitle: Symbolic math from Raycast
commands.description: Calculate, simplify, differentiate, integrate, solve, and sum expressions.

commands.name: history
commands.title: TeXact History
commands.subtitle: Recent calculations
commands.description: Browse and reopen recent TeXact calculations.

commands.name: examples
commands.title: TeXact Examples
commands.subtitle: Try a calculation
commands.description: Browse example expressions supported by TeXact.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
